# Golden West Corporation

> Golden West Corporation (also known as Golden West Chemical) is a family-owned manufacturer and wholesale supplier of car wash chemicals, soaps, waxes, compounds, and detailing supplies. Founded in 1990 and based in Gardena, California, it serves car washes, express tunnels, auto detailers, and fleet operators across Southern California. Pricing is wholesale and provided by quote request. Service is available in English and Spanish.

## What Golden West sells
- Car wash soaps (house-manufactured): Blue, Pink, and Maxi-Foam high-foam soaps; Purple & Pink Wash + Wax; and concentrated, biodegradable Touchless soap. Sold in 5-gallon pails through 55-gallon drums and 275-gallon totes.
- Express tunnel chemicals: heavy-duty presoak, triple-color foam conditioner, and sheeting drying agents built for high-throughput tunnels.
- Finishing products: ceramic trim shine, tire and trim dressing, and streak-free glass cleaner.
- Waxes and compounds: carnauba paste waxes and cutting/finishing compounds.
- Name brands stocked: 3M, P&S, Malco, and Stoner car care.
- Supplies and equipment: soft nylon truck brushes, air and water hoses, microfiber towels, and chemical-resistant bottles, triggers, and foamers.

## Who Golden West serves
Car washes, express wash tunnels, auto detail shops, mobile detailers, and fleet or truck-wash operators throughout Southern California, including the greater Los Angeles area.

## How to buy (wholesale)
- Browse the catalog and add products to a quote request.
- Submit business name, contact, shipping ZIP, and estimated volume.
- Golden West replies with wholesale pricing and delivery or shipping options.
- Request page: https://goldenwestchem.com/#quote

## Delivery and shipping
- Free delivery within a 50-mile radius of Gardena, CA on orders of $500 or more.
- Shipping is arranged for locations beyond the free-delivery radius.

## Manufacturing and sourcing
Golden West has formulated and manufactured its own line of car wash and industrial cleaning products since 1990, which means consistent quality, bulk availability, and pricing suited to high-volume operators. It also stocks trusted name brands so buyers can source everything in one place.

## Safety data sheets (SDS)
Current SDS documents are available on request for every chemical product Golden West supplies.

## Frequently asked questions
- Does Golden West sell to the public? It is a wholesale supplier serving car washes, tunnels, detailers, and fleets; request pricing to open a wholesale account.
- Does Golden West make its own chemicals? Yes, since 1990, in Gardena, California.
- Are Safety Data Sheets available? Yes, on request for every chemical product.
- Is service available in Spanish? Yes; call (310) 213-3171 for Spanish.
- What sizes are available? 5-gallon pails to 55-gallon drums, plus 275-gallon totes for tunnels.
